eyebrow: Turning a port into an exact answer
code:
nmap -sV -p 21,22,80 10.10.10.5

PORT   STATE SERVICE VERSION
21/tcp open  ftp     vsftpd 2.3.4
22/tcp open  ssh     OpenSSH 7.6p1 Ubuntu 4ubuntu0.3
80/tcp open  http    Apache httpd 2.4.29 ((Ubuntu))
caption: -sV matches responses against nmap-service-probes to pull exact version strings.

steps.label: --version-intensity 0
steps.sub: fastest — only the most common probes

steps.label: --version-intensity 9
steps.sub: slowest — every probe in the database

steps.label: -A
steps.sub: convenience flag: bundles -sV, -O, default scripts, traceroute

code:
nc -nv 10.10.10.5 21

220 (vsFTPd 2.3.4)

# NSE scripts add detail -sV alone won't show:
nmap -sV -sC -p- 10.10.10.5
nmap --script smb-os-discovery 10.10.10.5
caption: Banner grabbing reads the raw greeting yourself; -sC runs Nmap's default script set.
